title: Vector Sorting with Lambda
description: Sorts a vector of objects using a custom lambda comparator.
explanation_md: Demonstrates the use of `std::sort` with a lambda function to sort a collection of custom structures by a specific member.

title: Unique Pointer Usage
explanation_md: `std::unique_ptr` is a smart pointer that owns and manages another object through a pointer and disposes of that object when the unique_ptr goes out of scope.

title: Template Singleton Class
description: A reusable thread-safe Singleton pattern using templates.
explanation_md: Uses C++11 static local variable initialization (which is thread-safe) and templates to create a reusable Singleton base class.

title: RAII File Handler
description: Ensures files are closed automatically when the handler is destroyed.
explanation_md: Implements Resource Acquisition Is Initialization (RAII) to ensure file resources are properly released, preventing file descriptor leaks.

title: String Splitting Utility
description: Splits a string into a vector using a delimiter.
explanation_md: Uses `std::stringstream` and `std::getline` to parse a string into segments based on a specified character delimiter.
